thread:
maria: Trying the 'Get started' sample in the Console. I paste my API key, click 'Send test request' and the card shows 'Initializing...' forever. No error shown. Anyone?

devex-bot: infra-check: sample-app deployment up, logs show incoming request, no 500s.

kyle: Can you share browser console and a curl from your machine? Also is that a user key or a service key?

maria: curl I ran: `curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/responses -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_abc' -d '{"input":"hello"}'` -> 402
Response body: `{"error":"billing_required","message":"Workspace ws_maria requires billing activation"}`
Browser console: `TypeError: Failed to fetch` then the UI keeps spinning.

noah: 402 makes sense. The sample client currently treats network/4xx as transient and keeps retrying => spinner never ends. Console normally shows a billing banner but invited accounts sometimes don't render the CTA. Did you join via invite?

maria: Yep, I accepted an invite from a coworker. Workspace dropdown shows 'Trial (billing pending)'. There's no button to add a card.

kyle: Workaround for now: either add payment under Org -> Billing (if you have admin rights) or generate a service key from the API keys page and use that for the quickstart. To check: `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/orgs/me` -> look for `"billing_enabled": false`.

maria: That returned `{"id":"ws_maria","billing_enabled":false,"role":"admin"}`. Created a service key and the sample call succeeded (200). Thanks! :tada:

devex-bot: note created: DEVEX-418 "quickstart: stop infinite retry on 4xx and surface billing modal"

noah: I'll open two PRs: sample change to detect 402 and show explicit CTA; SDK change to map `billing_required` to a dedicated error class so apps can handle it without relying on status codes. Example patch in sample: `if (resp.status === 402) { showBillingModal('Activate billing to make API calls'); return; }`

kyle: Filing UX task UX-92 to ensure billing CTA shows for invited orgs when billing_enabled is false and the user has admin role. Also add a telemetry event when quickstart gets 402 so we can measure frequency.

maria: Confirmed service key fixed my quickstart. Happy to test PR once it's up. Thanks folks!

kyle: Assigning noah+kyle to DEVEX-418 + UX-92. Follow-ups: PRs for sample + SDK, console banner change. :raised_hands:
